title: RN – Patient Safety Officer (CPHRM)
description:
#PatientSafety #HealthcareLeadership #NursingCareers #ClinicalExcellence #QualityImprovement

RN – Patient Safety Officer

Location: Downey, CA
Schedule: Full-Time | Day Shift | 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM | No Weekend Requirement

Virtus Healthcare Staffing seeks a committed and experienced Patient Safety Officer (RN) to join our partner, a leading medical facility in Downey, CA. This essential role supports organizational goals of providing safe, high-quality patient care by leading patient safety initiatives, conducting root cause analyses, and driving quality improvement across the hospital environment.

Position Summary

The Patient Safety Officer (RN) serves as the principal advocate for patient safety, ensuring compliance with clinical regulations and fostering a culture of safety. This role involves strategic oversight of hospital-wide safety programs, evaluation of adverse events, and active collaboration with interdisciplinary teams to improve patient outcomes. The role demands a strong foundation in clinical practices, performance improvement methodologies, and regulatory standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and monitor compliance with National Patient Safety Goals and safety-related metrics.

  • Conduct Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and Failure Mode and Effect Analysis (FMEA) for adverse events and near-misses.

  • Collaborate with nursing, clinical, and administrative teams to implement proactive patient safety strategies.

  • Act as a liaison with regulatory bodies (e.g., CDPH) for reporting and managing adverse events.

  • Oversee data analysis for quality improvement initiatives using Lean/Six Sigma methodologies.

  • Participate in interdisciplinary committees related to falls, medication safety, and infection prevention.

  • Support staff training and competency development in safety awareness and evidence-based practices.

  • Maintain current knowledge of CMS, The Joint Commission, and California health regulations.

  • Conduct chart reviews to identify risk patterns and assist in developing corrective action plans.

  • Report safety trends and recommendations to senior leadership and contribute to performance dashboards.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in California.

  • Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or related field.

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in a clinical setting.

  • Minimum 2 years in a quality, patient safety, or risk management role.

  • Strong knowledge of CDPH reporting criteria and national safety standards.

  • Proven ability to analyze clinical events, interpret data, and lead interdisciplinary reviews.

  • Proficiency with CQI tools, EMR systems (e.g., Epic), and Microsoft Office Suite.

Preferred:

  • Master's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Quality, or Public Health.

  • Certification in Patient Safety, Risk Management, or Quality Improvement (e.g., CPPS, CPHQ).

  • Familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma or other process improvement tools.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonus structure.

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance.

  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support.

  • 401(k) with employer matching.

  • Paid Time Off (PTO), Holidays, and Sick Leave.

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

  • Career growth opportunities within a high-performing organization.

If you are a strategic and compassionate RN professional with a passion for patient safety and clinical excellence, we invite you to apply today and make a meaningful impact.

title: (RN) Clinical Infection Preventionist (CIC)
description:
#InfectionPrevention #PublicHealthJobs #DowneyCA #HealthcareLeadership

Virtus Healthcare Staffing is supporting the recruitment for our valued partner, a nationally recognized healthcare organization known for excellence in patient care, safety, and innovation. We are seeking an experienced Infection Preventionist IV to join their team in Downey, California in a full-time onsite role.

Infection Preventionist IV

Location: Downey, CA 90242
Category: Infection Prevention & Control
Job Type: Full-time (Onsite)
Salary: $128,500 – $151,100 annually
Relocation Assistance: Not specified

About Our Partner

Our partner is dedicated to creating healthier communities through advanced medical care, innovation, and a commitment to quality. They foster a culture where team members are empowered to lead, grow, and provide exceptional patient-centered care.

Job Summary

The Infection Preventionist IV is a key leader in implementing and evaluating infection prevention and control programs. This role involves conducting surveillance, maintaining infection data dashboards, participating in outbreak investigations, and educating staff on infection prevention practices. You will collaborate cross-functionally to promote a safe environment for patients, staff, and visitors.

Schedule

Full-time, Onsite
Monday – Friday, business hours with occasional flexibility for infection control activities as needed.

What Our Partner Offers

Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, paid time off, and PTO cash-out options.
Family Support: Employee assistance programs (EAP), access to Headspace®, backup child and elder care, and parental leave.
Professional Development: Award-winning education, certification support, and leadership development opportunities.
Culture of Excellence: A mission-driven team environment prioritizing safety, quality, and innovation.

Responsibilities

As an Infection Preventionist IV, you will:

  • Monitor infection control trends, maintain dashboards, and generate reports to support annual program plans.

  • Participate in investigations of infection outbreaks, exposure incidents, epidemics, and pandemics.

  • Provide infection prevention expertise to staff, patients, and other stakeholders, responding to inquiries and conducting educational programs.

  • Assist in developing and implementing infection prevention policies, procedures, and workflows.

  • Conduct on-site assessments of clinical spaces to ensure adherence to infection prevention standards.

  • Participate in performance improvement initiatives using data analytics and trend analysis.

  • Stay current on infection prevention regulations and accreditation standards at local, state, and federal levels.

  • Support organizational readiness for regulatory surveys and audits.

Minimum Qualifications

Education & Experience:

  • Master's degree in Nursing, Public Health, Epidemiology, Microbiology, or related field AND 2+ years of healthcare experience (including at least 1 year in infection prevention, patient management, or public health) OR

  • Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Public Health, Microbiology, or related field AND 4+ years of healthcare experience (including at least 3 years in infection prevention or related field) OR

  • Registered Nurse (RN) License without a bachelor's degree AND 6+ years of healthcare experience (including at least 5 years in infection prevention or related field) OR

  • Minimum 7 years of directly related healthcare/professional experience.

Certification:

  • Infection Control Certification (CIC) required within 24 months of hire.

Skills & Knowledge:

  • Advanced knowledge of infection prevention, epidemiology, and regulatory standards (CDC, NHSN).

  • Strong analytical skills for health care data and outcome trends.

  • Effective written and verbal communication and the ability to influence across teams.

  • Proficiency in developing and implementing performance improvement plans.

This is an opportunity to play a critical role in patient safety and infection prevention within a forward-thinking healthcare system. If you are a seasoned infection preventionist ready to advance your career in a leadership capacity, we encourage you to apply and join a team where your expertise will shape safer healthcare environments.

  • Education: Graduate of an accredited School of Surgical Technology.

  • Additional Requirements:

    • Knowledge of the sterile core area, sterile technique, and operating room procedures and equipment is essential.

    • Ability to follow instructions and exercise good judgment and discipline.

Benefits

The successful candidate will receive a competitive compensation package and access to comprehensive benefits, including:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.

Job Details at a Glance

Job Title: Senior Physician Assistant - Urgent Care | Location: Roseville, CA | Schedule: Full-Time, 36 hours/week (Rotating Evening/Weekend) | Hiring Incentive: Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits

Senior Physician Assistant - Urgent Care

Virtus Healthcare Staffing is searching for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Physician Assistant to join our partner's Urgent Care team in Roseville, CA. This is a unique opportunity for a professional who is not only a clinical expert but also a proven leader. You will provide a high level of clinical and operational expertise, serving as a mentor to less experienced Physician Assistants while delivering high-quality, team-based patient care.

Position Overview

As a Senior Physician Assistant, you will play a central role in diagnosing and treating a wide variety of illnesses and injuries. Your daily responsibilities will include performing comprehensive physical examinations, ordering and interpreting diagnostic tests, and performing therapeutic procedures such as injections, immunizations, and suturing. Your extensive experience will allow you to work independently on a complex rotating schedule, and you may collaborate on performance improvement activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Patient Assessment & Diagnosis: Examine patients, perform comprehensive physical exams, and compile medical data. Administer or order diagnostic tests, and interpret results to develop and implement patient management plans.

  • Procedural Expertise: Perform therapeutic procedures, including injections, immunizations, suturing, and wound care.

  • Mentorship and Leadership: By virtue of your experience, you will mentor less experienced Client and contribute to a positive and productive work environment. You may also collaborate with the supervising physician and management on operational and clinical improvements.

  • Specialty Support: Based on specific departmental needs, additional duties may include facilitating admissions, transfers, and discharges; performing pre- and post-operative procedures; and assisting in surgical procedures as applicable.

  • Patient Education: Instruct and counsel patients regarding compliance with prescribed regimens, health maintenance, and other relevant education.

Qualifications

  • Experience:

    • A minimum of three years of previous experience as a Physician Assistant within the last five years is required.

  • Education:

    • Graduate from an ARC-PA accredited physician assistant program.

  • Licenses and Certifications:

    • A California Physician Assistant License is required at hire.

    • A Physician Assistant National Certificate is required at hire.

    • Basic Life Support (BLS) is required at hire.

    • A National Provider Identifier is required at hire.

  • Additional Requirements:

    • A Fluoroscopy Permit is required or must be obtained within 18 months from the date of hire for specific specialties.

    • Must be able to work in a Labor/Management Partnership environment.

If you are a qualified and skilled Senior Physician Assistant ready for a rewarding career move, apply today through Virtus Healthcare Staffing.

Position Summary:

Virtus Healthcare Staffing is seeking a skilled and compassionate Registered Nurse (RN) to join the Renal Telemetry Unit at our esteemed partner medical facility in Everett, WA. This role offers a dynamic opportunity to work various shifts and FTEs, delivering specialized nursing care to adult and geriatric patients. You will manage individuals with primary renal conditions, often accompanied by co-morbid cardiac issues necessitating continuous telemetry monitoring. The ideal candidate will bring at least one year of acute care nursing experience and a strong dedication to patient safety, evidence-based practice, and collaborative care within this specialized unit.

Key Details:

  • Unit Focus: Renal Telemetry, caring for patients with acute/chronic kidney disease, electrolyte imbalances, and conditions requiring cardiac monitoring.
  • Schedule: Full-Time; Multiple shifts available (Day and Night, likely 12-hour configurations). Various FTE options available.
  • Experience Required: Minimum 1 year of nursing experience in an acute care setting.
  • Licensure/Certifications: Active Washington RN License and BLS (AHA) required upon hire.
  • Facility Culture: Our partner is committed to delivering world-class healthcare with a human connection, where your specialized skills and compassionate approach make a vital difference daily.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Comprehensive Clinical Care:
    • Conduct thorough nursing assessments for patients with renal disease and associated co-morbidities, focusing on cardiovascular and fluid/electrolyte status.
    • Continuously monitor, interpret, and respond to cardiac rhythms via telemetry, implementing appropriate interventions for arrhythmias and critical changes per established protocols.
    • Safely administer medications, including those specific to renal conditions and requiring renal dosage adjustments; manage IV therapies.
    • Develop, implement, and evaluate individualized patient care plans in collaboration with the interdisciplinary team, aiming to manage renal disease, prevent complications, and optimize cardiac health.
    • Provide care related to renal replacement therapies (e.g., pre- and post-dialysis care, assessment of access sites), as applicable to the unit's scope.
  • Patient Advocacy & Education:
    • Serve as a strong advocate for patients, particularly those managing chronic kidney disease, ensuring their autonomy and dignity are respected in care planning.
    • Educate patients and families on renal disease, dietary/fluid management, medication regimens, signs/symptoms of complications, and self-care strategies.
  • Safety, Quality & Professional Standards:
    • Uphold accountability for patient safety, vigilantly monitoring for complications of renal failure (fluid overload, electrolyte imbalances, uremia, infection).
    • Integrate evidence-based practices into daily care to enhance patient outcomes within the renal telemetry population.
    • Adhere to all safety protocols (patient, self, environmental) and practice to the full scope of licensure, guided by the Nurse Practice Act, ANA Code of Ethics, and nephrology/telemetry nursing standards.
  • Team Collaboration & Leadership:
    • Promote a culture of inquiry and continuous learning, exploring and disseminating research relevant to renal and telemetry care.
    • Collaborate effectively with nephrologists, cardiologists, dietitians, social workers, dialysis staff, and other members of the inter-professional care team.
    • Model professional nursing behaviors and contribute to a positive team environment.

Required Qualifications:

  • Graduation from an accredited nursing program (ADN, Diploma, or BSN).
  • Current, unrestricted Washington State Registered Nurse (RN) License upon hire.
  • Current National Provider BLS (Basic Life Support) certification from the American Heart Association upon hire.
  • Minimum of one (1) year of nursing experience in an acute care setting (e.g., medical-surgical, telemetry, step-down, or a dedicated nephrology unit).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN).
  • National Certification in a relevant area of specialty (e.g., Certified Nephrology Nurse - CNN, Progressive Care Certified Nurse - PCCN, Medical-Surgical Nursing - CMSRN) upon hire or willingness to obtain.
  • Prior experience working on a specialized renal, nephrology, or telemetry unit.
  • ACLS (Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support) certification.

Compensation & Benefits:

Our partner facility offers a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support its valued nursing staff. (More specific details will be shared during the interview process).

To Apply:

If you are a dedicated RN with a passion for caring for patients with complex renal conditions requiring telemetry monitoring, and you meet the required qualifications, we encourage you to apply for this enriching opportunity in Everett, WA.

#Medicine #Hiring #Jobseekers #Health #Healthcare

Emergency Medicine Physician

Level II Trauma Center | Full-Time, 12-hour Shifts | Bismarck, ND | Excellent Compensation & Benefits

Join a leading healthcare facility in Bismarck, ND, and experience a rewarding career in a collaborative and supportive environment. Virtus Healthcare Staffing is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Emergency Medicine Physician to provide high-quality emergency care within a Level II Trauma Center.

Provide Critical Care in a Dynamic Environment

As an Emergency Medicine Physician, you will be responsible for the independent evaluation, diagnosis, and treatment of patients presenting with a wide range of medical conditions. You will be an integral part of a dedicated team, working in a fast-paced and challenging environment where your expertise will make a real difference.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide comprehensive medical care to a diverse patient population presenting with a variety of emergency medical conditions.
  • Conduct thorough patient assessments, order and interpret diagnostic tests, and develop and implement appropriate treatment plans.
  • Perform a wide range of emergency procedures, including intubations, chest tubes, central lines, and critical care.
  • Collaborate effectively with other members of the healthcare team, including nurses, paramedics, and other specialists.
  • Maintain accurate and timely medical records.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Board-certified in Emergency Medicine (ABEM required).
  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 2 years of emergency medicine experience.
    • Specialized experience in trauma and advanced procedures in Level II or academic settings.
  • Licensure: Eligible for a North Dakota Medical License.
  • Certifications: ACLS, PALS, and ATLS required.
  • Skills: Comfortable with all ages, procedures, and trauma cases.

Schedule:

  • Full-time, 12-hour shifts (day/night/weekend rotations).
  • 40 hours of physician coverage daily.
  • No mid-level provider support.
  • 24-hour physician coverage.

Why Join Us?

  • Dedicated to Excellence: Work in a facility committed to excellence in patient care with a collaborative and supportive environment.
  • Make a Difference: Provide critical care to a diverse patient population in a Level II Trauma Center.
  • Excellent Compensation & Benefits:

      • $50,000 sign-on bonus.
      • Employer-paid health insurance (HSA option), 401K Safe-Harbor Plan (3% company contribution), $5,000 CME, paid professional liability insurance.
    • 1099 Independent Contractor (Living in the Community):
      • $275/hr base compensation + $10/hr quality bonus.
      • Annualized: Approximately $615,600 (based on 2,160 hours/year, including bonuses).
    • 1099 Independent Contractor (Travel):
      • $285/hr base compensation.
  • Relocation Assistance: $15,000 relocation assistance is available.
  • Bismarck, ND, offers a family-friendly community with a strong economy, a vibrant downtown area, and access to outdoor recreation.

Ready to provide exceptional emergency care and be part of a dedicated team? Apply today!

Location: Jacksonville, NC

Virtus Healthcare Staffing is seeking a compassionate and skilled School-Based Pediatric Occupational Therapist to join a leading outpatient rehab team serving children in the Jacksonville, NC area. In this dynamic role, you will provide school-based therapy services tailored to support students in achieving their educational goals and functional independence. You'll work alongside a collaborative, multidisciplinary team in a setting that emphasizes mentorship, family engagement, and exceptional clinical care.

The Occupational Therapist will support students' success by addressing fine motor, sensory integration, self-care, and daily living skills through individualized intervention plans. Working in close partnership with families, educators, and care teams, you will develop treatment strategies and contribute to the development of Individualized Education Plans (IEPs). Your focus will be to help students meet developmental milestones and participate fully in their learning environment.

Position Summary

  • Deliver direct occupational therapy services within a school setting based on physician referrals and IEP goals

  • Perform comprehensive evaluations, annual screenings, and ongoing assessments

  • Develop customized treatment plans and monitor progress through data collection and documentation

  • Educate families and school personnel on therapy strategies to reinforce progress

  • Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings and collaborate with educational staff

  • Maintain compliance with all regulatory, ethical, and organizational standards

Key Qualifications

  • Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapy program

  • Current or pending Occupational Therapist licensure in the state of North Carolina

  • Strong understanding of pediatric developmental milestones and sensory integration techniques

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a school-based team environment

  • Prior school-based OT experience preferred but not required

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive Salary with eligibility for sign-on bonus and student loan repayment options

  • Full benefits package available in your first month of employment

  • Generous PTO, paid holidays, and CEU incentives

  • Career advancement and leadership training through structured mentorship programs

  • Access to cutting-edge resources and clinical education partnerships (e.g., HSS, ABPTRFE)

  • Opportunities to pursue specialization in areas like Neuro, Pediatrics, Vestibular, Sensory Integration, and more

Clinical Environment

  • Setting: Public and private school systems with occasional outpatient support

  • Caseload: Diverse student population from Pre-K to high school

  • Focus Areas: Fine motor skills, handwriting, sensory processing, daily living skills, adaptive equipment, and classroom participation

This is more than a job—it's a chance to make a meaningful impact on children's lives while advancing your clinical career within a supportive, team-driven, and growth-oriented organization.

Apply today to become part of a mission that values inclusion, continuous learning, and delivering exceptional care to every child, every day.
